company_name: F Plus Ceramic Applied Materials Limited
semiconductor_relevance: High — F Plus Ceramic Applied Materials Limited specializes in advanced functional ceramics that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: F Plus Ceramic Applied Materials Limited is focused on developing advanced functional ceramic materials and integrated ceramic components for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include antistatic, porous, and thermal shock-resistant ceramics, which are essential for precision industrial manufacturing and semiconductor module applications.
capabilities: Advanced functional ceramic materials including plasma-resistant and ultra-low thermal expansion ceramics

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is located in Xiangshan District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan, and is committed to strengthening material localization.
